lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At the Harbor Cup skate final, rookie Mika has already fallen twice, while three-time champion Dax laughs from the rail.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Mika takes a breath and laces up her new Allbirds Tree Runner, choosing its breathable, lightweight feel for the warm day.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She rolls into the run, finds her rhythm, and lands it clean as the crowd erupts.

context: 30 second anime ad: rookie skater Mika, champion Dax, Harbor Cup final; Allbirds Tree Runner (breathable and lightweight; silky smooth and cool on your skin).
